additional_info.subject: RE: 0401479 - ID0401479-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P7 312547889/04] CORA10 issue CRM:02023000435
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE VIANEO
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / P7 312547889/04
Charger ID/Serial No.:
TTnuZt
Problem Description:
CORA 10 Error message: Terminal candidate list empty in the log
I hope this message finds you well. Site intervention will be necessary to resolve the error of "Terminal candidate list empty".
Kindly follow the troubleshooting steps:
Verify Ports
: Check that the correct ports are being used to connect the CORA10 to the OPM-C60.
Inspect Cable Connections
: Ensure the cable connection between the Processing Unit and the Card Reader is secure.
Reconnect Cables
: Reconnect all cables and restart the charger.
Replace CORA10
: If the issue persists, please consider exchanging the CORA10.
MLFB of CORA10: 8EM5903-0AA02-7AA1
You can find more about spare parts details here:
SICHARGE D HW rev. 0 Spare Part List - ID: 109814736 - Industry Support Siemens
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since
10/7/2024
, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
